Author: Ajay Bhanot

HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD ?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:AHC:148705 Court No. - 65 Case :- CRIMINAL MISC. BAIL APPLICATION No. - 10368 of 2024 Applicant :- Iqbal Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Hasan Parvej Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.
Matter is taken up in the revised call.

By means of this bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.
568 of 2023 at Police Station Baherhi, District Bareilly under Sections 498A, 306, 504, 506 I.P.C.
The applicant is in jail since 25.09.2023.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 16.02.2024.
The following arguments made by Shri Hasan Parvej, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant,
which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Shravan Kumar Dubey, learned AGA from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
Iqbal vs State Of U.P. on 11 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109366302/
1
1. The applicant is the husband of the deceased.
2. The applicant never tortured the deceased or demanded dowry.
3. The relations between the couple were harmonious.
4. The incident occurred on 17.09.2023.
The FIR was lodged on 19.09.2023.
5. Delay in lodgement of the FIR in the facts of this case is fatal to the prosecution case.
6. The applicant was falsely nominated only to extort money from him and to divert the course of investigation.
7. The deceased sustained injuries in a fire accident in the kitchen.
She was rushed to the hospital by the applicant.
The deceased was under treatment at a hospital before her death.
8. The applicant did not aid or abet the suicide.
9. The applicant had no motive to commit the offence.
10. The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from this case.
11. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to join the trial proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant- Iqbal be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
( ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

The learned trial court is directed to fix the sureties after due application of mind in light of the judgement passed by this Court in Arvind Singh v. State of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Deptt.
Iqbal vs State Of U.P. on 11 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109366302/
2 (Application U/S 482 No.2613 of 2023).
The learned trial court shall ensure that the right of bail of the applicant granted by this Court is not frustrated by arbitrary demands of sureties, or onerous conditions which are unrelated to the socioeconomic status of the applicant.
Order Date :- 11.9.2024
